entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • MapStaticAssets returns incorrect Content-Length for custom Range #63320
  • Implementing RendererInfo with Enum #63315
  • [Blazor] SetParametersAsync called multiple times with the same non-mutable parameters #63314
    Backlog
  • [SignalR] Blazor's Activity.Current is null when executing a HubMethod #63313
  • Confusing model binding / model validation behavior related to [Required] and value types #63311
  • Perf regression: fortunes #63310
  • Perf regression: fortunes, fortunes_ef, https #63309
  • Perf improvement: fortunes_dapper #63308

Closed

  • Support of \r\n characters in HTTP Headers as per HTTP 1.1 as per RFC 2616 sec 2.2 #61472
  • CVE-2018-8292 Explanation #61197
  • AspNetCoreModuleV2 deployment issues after installing .NET 9 runtime on server #60541
  • ASP.NET Core 2.1 becomes ASP.NET Core 2.3 #58598
  • InvalidOperationException when using string[] parameters with FromForm attribute #62326
    Backlog
  • Razor Pages equivalent of ViewComponents #63273
  • Minimal does not set response type nullability #58681
    10.0-rc1
  • .NET 9 OpenAPI incorrect schema for array of nullable strings #60803

PullRequests

Created

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #63324
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
  • Fix SetCookieHeaderValue.TryParse throwing ArgumentOutOfRangeException for Max-Age overflow #63323
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Fix memory leak in IIS StartupHook by properly disposing PhysicalFileProvider #63322
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Fix memory leak in CertificateManager.ImportCertificate method #63321
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Bump form-data from 4.0.2 to 4.0.4 #63312
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, javascript, dependencies, build-ops
  • Model nullable types using oneOf in OpenAPI schema #63301
    feature-openapi, area-minimal

Merged

  • Added string arrays to simple binding #63072
    community-contribution, pr: pending author input, area-minimal, 10.0-rc1
  • [10.0-rc1] Mop up changes that missed the RC1 snap #63318
    tell-mode
  • Add servicing-consider label to 10.0 PRs #63319
    needs-area-label, 10.0-rc1
  • [release/10.0-rc1] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #63293
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:

Updated

  • feat: "Spanify" DataProtector #62903
    area-dataprotection, pending-ci-rerun
  • Added usage of TimeProvider instead of DateTimeOffset #63042
    area-identity, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • Initialize hosting trace with OTEL tags for sampling #62090
    community-contribution, area-hosting
  • [Validation] Use [JsonPropertyName] for display name #63291
    community-contribution, area-minimal, feature-validation
  • [main] (deps): Bump src/submodules/googletest from `373af2e` to `244cec8` #63272
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
